name: Fedwire/CHIPS Structured-Address Migration
outcome: Fedwire and CHIPS structured-address readiness for the 2026-11-16 cutover. Lint a single message (art-349, network param selects fedwire or chips -- rules are byte-identical between the two networks), gate on the lint result: a fully compliant message ends the chain immediately, anything else continues to a batch sweep (art-350) of the full payment file for a rejection-risk report, then a before/after remediation diff receipt (tools/548) binding both file digests and the rule-clearance delta a bank shows its regulator or correspondents.
